style: Production enemy sprite sheet for a Chinese dark-fantasy idle RPG inspired by classic late-1990s isometric ARPG aesthetics. Hand-painted pre-rendered 3D sprite appearance, grounded adult proportions, detailed weathered bronze, iron, bone, leather and fur. NOT cartoon, NOT chibi, NOT glossy mobile toy, NOT pixel art. Consistent three-quarter front camera from 25 degrees above, all creatures face slightly toward lower-left. Warm key light from upper-left, cool restrained shadows, crisp silhouette, medium-value readable body, controlled highlights. Muted earth/bronze/ivory/slate palette with small ember accents. No purple or magenta anywhere on creatures. Full body including all feet, wings, horns, weapons and tails. Combat-ready idle stance. No environment, no floor, no terrain, no cast shadows, no particles, no glow outside silhouette, no text, letters, numbers, captions, borders, logos or watermarks. Flat perfectly uniform solid #FF00FF magenta chroma-key background throughout every empty area, including gaps within limbs. This is an extraction plate, not a game screenshot.
layout: Canvas exactly 1536x1024. EXACTLY SIX different isolated monsters arranged in EXACT equal 3-column x 2-row grid, each cell exactly 512x512. No grid lines. Centers at (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768). Exactly ONE full-body creature per cell. Fit the entire subject in its cell with at least 48 pixels of pure magenta clearance on ALL four sides. Keep feet close to y=440 within each cell. Same consistent rendering style across every monster. Fill about 75 percent of each cell, preserve broad wings and tails inside the cell.

background_edit_prompt: Edit this image into a usable sprite extraction plate. Preserve all six monster identities, detail, colors and poses. Remove EVERY background pixel and ALL lighting gradients behind the creatures. The entire empty background MUST be one exact flat neon MAGENTA color #FF00FF, including between legs, under arms and all holes. Do NOT use brown, grey, black, white or transparent-checkerboard backgrounds. No shadows, no floor, no vignette. Shrink and reposition all six monsters so they occupy six separate 512x512 cells in an exact 3 columns by 2 rows grid. Each creature, including all its weapons, feet, tail, claws, must fit inside its cell with 48px of magenta margin all around. Do not draw visible grid lines, labels or text. Keep ALL six complete bodies uncropped. The final image is 1536x1024. Background removal and generous separation are the purpose of this edit.
generation_note: Generated in six groups; sheets 2-6 used reviewed sheet 1 as style reference. Sheets 1,2,4,6 required a second background-removal edit. Accepted extraction plates are pinned by SHA-256; API regeneration is not deterministic. Static full-body idle illustrations only, no animation frames.
